title: AI-powered Precision Recycling System (WIMPLE)
summary: Seoreu reports that WIMPLE enabled cleaner recycling collection in previously unsorted Busan public spaces and improved collection planning.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: The Busan Facilities Corporation pilot separates recyclables at the point of disposal. Seoreu reports better separation, reduced contamination, and improved collection scheduling. A related Canadian sorting system reportedly achieved over 98% accuracy. Wider recycling-rate and pollution benefits remain intended and have not been measured in the Busan pilot.
purpose: Improve collection and separation of recyclable materials.
location: Busan, South Korea; Canada (related sorting development)

ratings.reason: The Busan Facilities Corporation pilot reportedly enabled recycling collection in previously unsorted public spaces and improved material separation.
The submission describes environmental mechanisms but gives no measured emissions, pollution, or ecosystem change for the pilot.

ai_role.statement: The account does not isolate AI’s contribution from the surrounding workflow.

evidence.citation: International Telecommunication Union, AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025). Project-submitted account, current as of June 2025. ITU provides no independent outcome evaluation.
evidence.title: Use Case 6: AI-powered Precision Recycling System (WIMPLE)

produced_by: The account does not establish conditions sufficient to reproduce the benefit.
must_hold: The account does not establish requirements for reproducing the benefit in other settings.

headline: WIMPLE enables recycling collection in Busan public spaces
claim_basis: Sources: the makers' report. The cited evidence includes no independent source and no finding by a regulator or court.
